name: listerin E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1

function.text: LTN1 is the approved symbol for listerin E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in ribosomal large subunit binding; ubiquitin protein ligase activity; protein autoubiquitination.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.
